Free Trade Zone Act, 2014 Free Trade Zone Regulations, 2014 Contents Article 1 Citation and commencement Article 2 Security within a free trade zone Article 3 Offices and inspection posts Article 4 No illegal building or structure Article 5 No transfer of dutiable goods Article 6 Keeping of accurate records Article 7 Directions Free Trade Zone Act, 2014 Free Trade Zone Regulations, 2014 Article 1 Citation and commencement These Regulations may be cited as the Free Trade Zone Regulations, 2014 and shall come into operation on the same day as the Free Trade Zone Act, 2014.
Article 2 Security within a free trade zone The free trade zone authority shall— (a) cause a fence or wall to be erected and maintained along the boundaries of the free zone, together with suitable gates;
(b) keep the fence or wall and the gates illuminated during such times as the authority considers necessary;
(c) comply with such other directions as the Minister may give in order to prevent the unauthorised entry or exit of persons or goods into or from the free zone.
Article 3 Offices and inspection posts The free trade zone authority shall provide facilities for the establishment of office accommodation for customs inspection posts within the zone.
Article 4 No illegal building or structure No building or structure shall be erected within 6 metres of the boundary of a free trade zone except with the written permission of the Director of Customs.
Article 5 No transfer of dutiable goods
(1) No person shall transfer dutiable goods from one free trade zone to another free trade zone except with the prior written permission of a customs officer.
(2) A person seeking such written permission shall submit a declaration in such form and manner as the authority may prescribe.
(3) In granting permission under these Regulations, a customs officer may impose such conditions as he considers appropriate.
Article 6 Keeping of accurate records
(1) A person permitted by the authority under regulation 9 to assemble, mix or manage goods within a free trade zone shall keep complete and accurate records of the permitted operations, including such particulars as the authority may require.
(2) Such records shall be produced for inspection on demand by a senior customs officer.
Article 7 Directions
(1) No person shall enter or leave a free trade zone without the permission of the authority of that zone.
(2) A person granted permission shall comply with the directions of the authority.
Made this 28th day of February, being the beginning of the year 1436 Hijri, corresponding to 21 December 2014.
